Name: No Transitions
Author: crazywig
Description: Removes the fade to black transition when warping around the map. This transition in the game adds about 3-5 seconds whenever you "warp", ie move to the edge of a map or through a door. I find this delay annoying so I decided to remove it.

Downloads.Description: New implementation should have less side effects, tested on SDV 1.5.1

Manifest.Name: No Transitions
Manifest.Description: Removes black screen transitions to speed up gameplay when moving
